summary: PowerShell code follows conventions well (Set-StrictMode, error handling, approved verbs; YAML has correct permissions/actions/shell). Design shows good separation with mockable seams. However, critical execution artifacts are missing: act-result.txt (explicitly required), actionlint validation output, and act pipeline validation. Workflow references tests/DependencyLicenseChecker.Tests.ps1 but tests aren't shown (intentional per task). Format-ComplianceReport (lines 160–210) could split three format branches into separate functions. The full TDD/validation cycle (red-green-refactor, actionlint, act runs) lacks evidence of completion—no proof tests pass through act, no act-result.txt appending test outputs, no actionlint exit-code verification. Solid code design undermined by incomplete delivery of required CI/CD artifacts.
